title: Ground truth gt_07_golden.xlsx leaves a genuine cross-sheet reference error unfixed in DCF Model!D85:F85, penalizing agents across 98 cascading cells
evidence: The task provides `/home/model/Desktop/Incorrect Cross Sheet References_input.xlsx` and instructs the agent: "Please audit and fix this file thoroughly. Errors may include but are not limited to: formula logic errors or inconsistencies, hardcoded values that should be formulas, broken cell references..." Between `untouched_input_Incorrect Cross Sheet References_input.xlsx` and `gt_07_golden.xlsx`, 10 cross-sheet reference cells were updated (`Football Field!E6`, `Football Field!G6`, `Frans Shares!L16`, `LBO & Lenders!S37:X37`, and `Equity Returns!D5`). However, `gt_07_golden.xlsx` leaves an identical cross-sheet row-offset bug unfixed in `DCF Model!D85:F85`: row 85 is labeled `Inventory` (`C85`), yet `D85:F85` contain `='BS & CF'!E10`, `='BS & CF'!F10`, and `='BS & CF'!G10` (`120, 120, 152`), which point to row 10 (`Property and Equipment, Net`) on `'BS & CF'` instead of row 9 (`Inventory`, `'BS & CF'!E9:G9` = `480, 534, 568`). When an agent fixes `DCF Model!D85:F85` to `'BS & CF'!E9:G9`, the change cascades through 98 cells in `DCF Model` (`D85:L90`, `G98:L99`, `Q94:R98`), `Football Field` (`E5:G5`), and `LBO & Lenders` (`X36`, `S43:X47`, `R62:R63`), causing the sole verifier `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (weight: 1) to fail with `Regression error at DCF Model!D85: answer=120, output=480; Regression error at DCF Model!D86: answer=11.0745891276865, output=44.2983565107459; Regression error at DCF Model!D89: answer=-58, output=302; ...` and score 0.0.
confirmation: In gt_07_golden.xlsx DCF Model row 85 is labelled Inventory but D85:F85 = 'BS & CF'!E10:G10 (Property and Equipment, 120/120/152) instead of row 9 Inventory (480/534/568); an agent fixing this cross-sheet error diverges from the key across many dependent cells.
fix: Answer key: DCF Model D85:F85 (Inventory) now read ='BS & CF'!E9/F9/G9 (480/534/568) instead of row 10 PP&E (120/120/152). The cached values of the 103 dependent cells were taken from a LibreOffice recalculation: Football Field E5:G5, DCF Model D85:L90, G98:L100, O30:T35, O64:T71, Q97:R101, and LBO & Lenders S43:X47, R62, R63. Only those cells changed. This is one more cross-sheet reference error of the same kind as the 10 the key already fixes, so a thorough audit is now rewarded, not penalized.

title: Ground truth gt_07_golden.xlsx stores unconverged iterative circular-reference values in LBO & Lenders!T49:X59 and fails its own verifier (score=0.0)
evidence: In `LBO & Lenders`, the debt schedule in `S49:X54` has an iterative circular reference (`T50 = T53 - T52`, `T51 = SUM(T49:T50)`, `T53 = T54 * AVERAGE(T49, T51)` with `calcPr iterate="true" iterateCount="100" iterateDelta="0.0001"`). None of `S49:X54` depends on any of the 10 formulas modified between `untouched_input_Incorrect Cross Sheet References_input.xlsx` and `gt_07_golden.xlsx`. However, `untouched_input_Incorrect Cross Sheet References_input.xlsx` and `gt_07_golden.xlsx` store different unconverged intermediate cached values in `T49:X59` (for example, `LBO & Lenders!T50` is cached as `-9.090303` in `untouched_input` and `-7.494374` in `gt_07_golden.xlsx`, whereas the converged fixed point is `-7.244009`; `X50` is `-11.639563` in `untouched_input`, `-16.826373` in `gt_07_golden.xlsx`, and `-12.071742` at the converged fixed point). Because `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` (weight: 1) runs `managed_recalculated_xlsx(Path(output_path), force_recalculation=True, model_deliverable=True)` on the submitted file and compares against the un-recalculated cached values of `gt_07_golden.xlsx`, grading `gt_07_golden.xlsx` against itself fails with `score=0.0` (`FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.8358. 17 cell error(s): Modification error at LBO & Lenders!T50: answer=-7.49437449150413, output=-7.25996975435565; Modification error at LBO & Lenders!U50: answer=-9.02735612840306, output=-8.29828677938158; ...`).
confirmation: LBO & Lenders T50 is cached -9.09 in the untouched input and -7.49 in the GT though no edited cell feeds it, and X53 cache is inconsistent with its formula, so these iteration-noise cells are graded as required modifications that recalculation cannot reproduce.
fix: Removed the circular debt-schedule cells from answer_position: 'LBO & Lenders' U49:X49, T50:X51, T53:X53, T57:X59 and X46 (the range is now split into row runs). None of the cross-sheet fixes feeds those cells, and their cached values are unconverged iteration states. Locally, the new key graded against itself passes, and so does the input with all 13 fixes written by openpyxl (no cached values).

title: Golden gate: the ground-truth deliverable does not score full reward
evidence: The ground-truth deliverable, staged at the verifiers' own output paths and graded by the problem's real grader, scored 0.00 (need >= 1.00). A correct answer that does not earn full reward means a verifier false-negatives the mandated work. With the ground truth staged, every one of the 1 checks on /home/model/Desktop/output.xlsx scored 0 (summed weight 1.000), which is the whole shortfall of the GT grade. A correct deliverable does not fail every check at once; the ground truth for this file most likely never reached the grader (paired with a file of another type or name), so these are not 1 separate verifier defects. title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells trivially fails every run (including gt_07_golden.xlsx itself and Unit 2's accurate cross-sheet reference fixes)
evidence: Across all 3 units, `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (weight: 1) scored `0.0`: Unit 1 (`regression 0.9897, modification 0.3731, 145 cell error(s)`), Unit 2 (`regression 0.9909, modification 0.6418, 115 cell error(s)`), and Unit 3 (`regression 0.9899, modification 0.4328, 139 cell error(s)`). Independent trajectory reconstruction shows that Unit 2 (steps `[30]`–`[58]`) identified and fixed all 10 ground-truth cross-sheet reference errors (`Football Field!E6, G6`, `Frans Shares!L16`, `LBO & Lenders!S37:X37`, `Equity Returns!D5`) as well as the genuine cross-sheet reference error in `DCF Model!D85:F85` (`='BS & CF'!E10:G10` -> `='BS & CF'!E9:G9`, so `Inventory` on `DCF Model` row 85 points to `Inventory` on `BS & CF` row 9 instead of `Property and Equipment, Net` on row 10), and converged the workbook in LibreOffice. Re-running the verifier logic confirms that fixing `DCF Model!D85:F85` on top of `gt_07_golden.xlsx` accounts for 98 of Unit 2's 115 errors (`Regression error at DCF Model!D85: answer=120, output=480; ...`), while the remaining 17 errors (`LBO & Lenders!T50:X59`) occur because `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` force-recalculates `output_path` in LibreOffice and compares it against un-recalculated, unconverged iterative circular-reference values cached in `gt_07_golden.xlsx`. Passing `gt_07_golden.xlsx` itself into `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` also fails with `score=0.0` (`regression 1.0000, modification 0.8358, 17 cell error(s)`), making a passing score unattainable.
confirmation: gt_07_golden.xlsx caches unconverged circular values in LBO & Lenders (X53 cached 109.638 vs formula X54*AVERAGE(X49,X51)=113.36 from its own cached inputs), so forced recalculation of even the golden file mismatches those modification cells and the sole all-or-nothing check fails.
fix: Removed the circular debt-schedule cells from answer_position: 'LBO & Lenders' U49:X49, T50:X51, T53:X53, T57:X59 and X46 (the range is now split into row runs). None of the cross-sheet fixes feeds those cells, and their cached values are unconverged iteration states. Locally, the new key graded against itself passes, and so does the input with all 13 fixes written by openpyxl (no cached values).
